subject: Next step: Dedicated capacity sizing call — proposed times & prework
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elliot Barnes <elliot@finova-pay.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Next step: Dedicated capacity sizing call — proposed times & prework

Elliot,

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today — appreciate the clear description of the payment-routing use cases. Quick recap and proposed next step: we should schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) to lock in throughput/latency requirements and map those to a Dedicated pool recommendation.

High-level we heard:
- Primary workload: real-time payment routing and AML risk scoring
- Target production QPS estimate (from call): ~120–200 rps steady state; occasional bursts to ~500 rps for short windows
- Typical prompt sizes: ~250–400 tokens (avg ~300)
- Latency target: p95 under 200ms for critical paths

Proposed agenda for the sizing call (45–60m):
1) Quick intro & goal alignment (5m)
2) Walk through current traffic profile and peak patterns (10m)
3) Redwood serving architecture/quantization options & batching tradeoffs (15m)
4) Sizing recommendations (GPU count / pool config / autoscale) (10–15m)
5) Action items & handoffs (5m)

I attached a short CSV template (redwood-sizing-template.csv) to capture QPS, payload sizes, and concurrency patterns — if you can pre-fill the key rows before the call it speeds things up. Also attached a brief security snapshot we can expand on later.

Would the following slots work for your team next week?
- Tue 2027-09-07 09:00–10:00 PT
- Tue 2027-09-07 13:00–14:00 PT
- Wed 2027-09-08 11:00–12:00 PT

If those don't fit, drop a couple times and we will adapt. I can also share a Calendly link for direct booking.

CCing Grace (solutions architect) to lead the technical portion and Marissa (CS lead) to cover onboarding.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: redwood-sizing-template.csv (CSV template for QPS / payloads)
Attachment: precall_security_snapshot.pdf (2-page snapshot)
From: Elliot Barnes <elliot@finova-pay.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2027 17:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next step: Dedicated capacity sizing call — proposed times & prework

Marcus — thanks for the recap and clear agenda. That looks good. A couple quick clarifications before we confirm a slot: 

1) We'd like the deep-dive to include a short segment on prefix/KV cache behavior and tokenization impact for our hybrid prompts — our infra lead Sanjay Patel should join that section. Is Grace able to cover caching strategies?

2) For prework, we can fill the CSV but can you confirm the fields you most care about? We can definitely provide avg payload size and 99th percentile payload size, but we'd need a short list of expected columns so we match your template.

As for times, Tue 09:00 PT conflicts with a board meeting for a couple of our folks. Wed 11:00–12:00 PT looks ideal. If you can lock that one, we'll invite Sanjay (sanjay@finova-pay.com) and a PM.

—Elliot
Elliot Barnes
Head of Platform | Finova Pay, Inc.
elliot@finova-pay.com
+1 (212) 555-0174

Elliot — great, Wed 2027-09-08 11:00–12:00 PT is confirmed on our side. Sending a calendar invite now.

Quick answers to your questions:
- Grace will lead the cache / tokenization portion and can walk through how KV caching and prefix reuse influence effective throughput.
- The CSV we attached has the columns we care about: endpoint name, avg qps, 95th qps, 99th qps, avg prompt tokens, 95th prompt tokens, request concurrency, typical response token count, and any special model behaviors (e.g. reranking). If you send a trimmed version that's fine — the key ones are avg/95/99 qps and avg/95 token sizes.

Operational notes (to prep):
- For initial sizing, tell us whether you'll expect sustained 120–200 rps or if your traffic is bursty with long quiet periods between spikes — that changes the recommended pool/instance sizing vs autoscale config.
- Your stated latency SLO p95 < 200ms is achievable in a Dedicated pool with appropriate batching + prefix cache for these prompt sizes; we'll validate numbers on the call.

Attachments: redwood-sizing-template.csv (attached now).
